# PhotonicSynapticPlasticity

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The modulation of optical coupling strengths between nodes in a photonic network, analogous to synaptic weight changes in biological neurons. Bridges TCC interconnect reconfigurability with iNEST learning, enabling unified hardware for adaptive, high-speed neural computation.
